# infrawrench_drift_alert_settings (Resource)

Which resource changes discovered by a sync raise a drift notification, and how often the organization can be told.

An organization **singleton**. There is no DELETE on this route, so `terraform destroy` leaves the stored settings as they are rather than inventing a reset — unlike the cost settings, these have no documented shipped values to restore to.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cooldown_minutes` (Number) Least time between drift notifications for this organization, 5–1440. One notification per window, no matter how many changes or accounts it covers.
- `min_changes` (Number) Fewest matching changes in a window worth notifying about, 1–1000.
- `notify_created` (Boolean) Alert on resources that appeared.
- `notify_deleted` (Boolean) Alert on resources that disappeared.
- `notify_updated` (Boolean) Alert on field-level updates. Usually `false`: updates are the bulk of the volume and are most often a provider restating a value it already had.

### Optional

- `account_ids` (List of String) Accounts to alert on, at most 200. Omit it — or give an empty list — for every account, including ones connected later.

Computed as well as optional because the server always returns the key: an empty list and an omitted attribute mean the same thing to it, so removing the attribute keeps whatever was last applied rather than clearing it. Set it to `[]` to widen back to every account.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Drift alerting is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_drift_alert_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
